tasks.gr10-analytical-geometry-t3: Topic: Analytical geometry. Cover the distance between two points, the gradient of a line, the midpoint of a line segment, parallel lines (equal gradients), perpendicular lines (gradients with product -1), finding an end point from a midpoint, collinear points and finding the fourth vertex of a parallelogram. Ask Grade 10 learners to calculate with given coordinates, with answers that are exact (whole numbers or fractions).
tasks.gr10-finance-growth-t3: Topic: Finance and growth. Cover simple interest A = P(1 + in), compound interest A = P(1 + i)^n, compound interest paid monthly, hire purchase (deposit, balance, simple interest, monthly instalment), inflation, population growth and exchange rates. Use South African rand with a decimal comma. Ask Grade 10 learners to calculate amounts, interest, principals and time, rounded to the nearest cent.
tasks.gr10-statistics-t3: Topic: Statistics. Cover the median, lower and upper quartiles, the range and interquartile range, the five-number summary, box-and-whisker plots, the mean, grouped data (class midpoints, estimated mean, modal class, median class) and the effect of adding a constant to every value. Ask Grade 10 learners to calculate from small data sets and from grouped frequency tables.
tasks.gr10-measurement-t3: Topic: Measurement. Cover the surface area and volume of spheres, hemispheres, cones (slant height), square-based pyramids, prisms, cylinders and composite solids, and converting cm3 to litres. Ask Grade 10 learners to calculate with given dimensions, with answers to one decimal place and with the units shown.
tasks.gr10-trig-geometry-t3: Topic: Trigonometry in two dimensions and geometry riders. Cover angles of elevation and depression, solving right-angled triangles to find a side or an angle, two angles of elevation of the same tower, isosceles triangles and multi-step problems. Ask Grade 10 learners to calculate lengths and angles to one decimal place.
